description: This file provides shell completion support for Git commands in Bash and Zsh shells, including functions for completing references, commands, options, and integrating with shell environments.

methods.name: __git_find_repo_path
methods.description: Discovers the path to the git repository considering options like --git-dir and -C.

methods.name: __git
methods.description: Runs git command respecting __git_C_args and __git_dir options.

methods.name: __git_eread
methods.description: Reads the first line of a file into a variable.

methods.name: __git_complete_refs
methods.description: Completes refs based on mode, remote, and other options.

methods.name: __git_dwim_remote_heads
methods.description: Lists remote branches used for DWIM completion.

methods.name: __git_ls_files_helper
methods.description: Helper for listing files in the index for completion.

methods.name: __git_complete_index_file
methods.description: Completes index files based on options.
